title: Juicy Crunchy American Ground Beef Stir-fry
description: A fresh and juicy meal-prep dish featuring keto-friendly ground beef with a crunchy texture that's perfect for any lunch or snack.
instructions: Heat oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Add ground beef and cook until browned, breaking up with a spatula. Remove from pan when done.
In the same skillet, sauté onions and bell peppers until softened.
Add garlic, sugar, salt, and pepper to taste in the skillet. Stir-fry for 1-2 minutes or until fragrant.
Return ground beef to skillet and stir together with vegetables. Cook for another minute.
Slice dumplings if desired and add them into the skillet. Mix well and cook until heated through.
